This Certificate does not bestow any form of legal international approval. *Important note*: Apart from the mention of the Certificate's reference number and the name of the OIML Member State in which the Certificate was issued, partial quotation of the Certificate and of the associated OIML Test Report(s) is not permitted, although either may be reproduced in full.
